sentences.text: Hush... at 04:40, the sensors in the teenager's room began to stir, hinting at a coming presence.
The air was meant to be within the expected range of 21.1 °C to 21.9 °C.
But around 04:50, a strange warmth with no source began to thicken the air.
The temperature climbed dramatically, spiking from the expected 21.5 °C to a sudden 22.9 °C.
This unnatural peak held fast for thirty minutes before gently fading away near 05:10.
